files.name: Next Agent 0.7.18 — Lifecycle-Safe HUD + Full-Screen Apps
files.notes: Next Agent 0.7.18 makes Show HUD a direct SpringBoard broadcast test and changes self-test to require actual RootHide HUD tweak injection instead of merely expecting a fallback. Routine app automation remains full-screen.

files.name: Next Agent Daemon 0.7.18 — RootHide
files.notes: Matching RootHide helper for Next Agent 0.7.18. Installs the SpringBoard OCR/HID bridge, direct HUD-test broadcaster, tweak-load diagnostics and root helper; the HUD remains a separate RootHide tweak.

files.name: Next Agent System HUD 0.7.18 — RootHide
files.notes: RootHide HUD stack now retries startup through UIApplication and UIWindowScene lifecycle events, preserving exact-bundle and known-app fallback injection while exposing bootstrap attempts, scene readiness and timeout state.

files.name: Next Post 1.0.14 — No Ads + No Repeats
files.notes: Removes all advertising UI, IronSource/LevelPlay SDK dependencies, interstitials, test controls and advertising metadata. Generated articles are permanently marked used with domain-independent IDs; when Remaining reaches zero, the app waits for newly published articles and never starts a repeat cycle. The searchable Remaining selector, automatic post composer, Refresh, Copy Text and Open in X remain.

files.name: Next Post 1.0.13 — Selectable Remaining
files.notes: Restores the complete 1.0.11 automatic X post generation flow and removes the 1.0.12 Your Take/protected-queue behavior. Remaining now opens a searchable list of unused articles; select any article and Generate creates the full post automatically, marks it used, and updates Remaining. Random Generate, Refresh Articles, Copy Text, Open in X, preview card and focused hashtags remain as in 1.0.11.

files.name: Next Post 1.0.12 — Protected Queue + Your Take
files.notes: Fixes Remaining/history migration using domain-independent article IDs and an explicit protected queue. Refresh only adds genuinely new articles. Selecting an article no longer consumes it; it is consumed only when Open in X is tapped. Adds a mandatory user-written Your Take field with verified article context, while preserving the Next Jailbreak link/card and focused hashtags.

files.name: Next Post 1.0.11 — Original Content + Refresh
files.notes: Updates Next Post for X original-content posting. Generated posts now use X-specific Next Jailbreak editorial framing instead of reusing the article meta description, while keeping the Next Jailbreak article URL and X preview card. Adds Refresh Articles with cache bypass and new-article detection; newly published site articles are added to Remaining without resetting used-history or the current cycle. Manual Open in X flow remains unchanged.

files.name: LiveTouch 0.1.7 — Final Cleanup
files.notes: Final cleanup-only build. Adds Uninstall LiveTouch Files and Respring to Finish Cleanup. Removes LiveTouchEngine dylib/plist from RootHide ElleKit and legacy tweak paths, deletes saved wallpaper data, preferences and engine log. This TIPA intentionally contains no LiveTouchEngine payload and cannot reinstall the wallpaper engine. After cleanup and one respring, delete LiveTouch from TrollStore.

files.name: Next Multi Browser 1.1.10 — Device Category Modes
files.notes: Adds four global environment device modes to the main Random Environment control: iOS Mode assigns random iPhone presets, Android Mode assigns random Android phones, PC / Mac Mode mixes Windows Chrome and macOS Safari desktop presets, and Mixed Mode combines all categories. Selecting a mode immediately randomizes all 20 profiles, and the saved Auto Randomize timer continues using that selected mode. Cookies, Google logins, persistent website data, profile isolation, iPad Pro layout, URL queue, AutoFill, auto refresh, and VPN features remain intact.

files.notes: Auto Log Collector release. files.name: NextLock 1.1.5 CPU Fix Test 11 Live Features RootHide
files.notes: Test 11 keeps the validated CPU/photo fixes and independent Time/Date font controls. It adds a direct post-render runtime fix for both Time and Date position, color and shadow/glow, and adds visible function labels above every Time/Date movement slider.

files.name: Next Quick Reminder 1.0.16 — Persistent Wake RootHide
files.notes: Replaces the unreliable 30-second SpringBoard polling scheduler with PCPersistentTimer and system waking enabled for locked-device scheduled sends. Keeps the working fresh pending-reminder PDF generation, newest-3 retention, selected weekdays/time preferences, and Gmail file-share sender unchanged.

files.name: Next Reminder 1.3.28 — Stable Files Rollback
files.notes: Stability rollback for the persistent Files freeze. Restores the entire File Sharing implementation to the verified pre-report stable source instead of carrying any Pending Report/PDF/background-send UI code in the Files view. Keeps the current app data, other app updates, Live Activity version alignment, and compiled AppIcon fix. Pending Report generation is temporarily removed from the app while Files stability is verified.

files.name: Next Reminder 1.3.31 — Gmail Report Recovery Fix
files.notes: Fixes Pending Reports Send Email when Gmail tests successfully but the file-share request sees a stale connector. Send Report now uses the same secure Gmail recovery mechanism as the working email test path, synchronizes any refreshed connector ID, retries the PDF once, and shows the real HTTP/server error if retry still fails. Stable Files implementation remains unchanged.

files.name: Next Accounts 1.0.6 — Search & Swipe Delete
files.notes: Adds a native email search bar with case-insensitive filtering and a clear no-results state. Each account can now be deleted with a simple left swipe, including full-swipe deletion, and the updated list is saved immediately in Keychain. Existing account editing, one-tap copy, platform status buttons, automatic local generators, bulk import, Generate 5 More and the independent in-app browser remain unchanged.

files.name: Next Accounts 1.0.5 — Independent Browser
files.notes: Removes all hold gestures and signup actions from the platform cards, leaving one reliable tap to toggle and persist each green status. The separate Browser tab now opens Google by default and includes a manual address/search bar plus back, forward, home, stop and reload. The in-app WKWebView keeps normal website data without coupling browser navigation to accounts. Automatic local email/password suggestions, editor generators, Generate 5 More, bulk import, one-tap copy and Keychain persistence remain included.

files.name: Next Accounts 1.0.4 — In-App Signup Browser
files.notes: Fixes platform-card taps so a normal tap reliably toggles and persists the green status. Press and hold now switches to a dedicated second Browser tab inside Next Accounts and loads the selected platform's signup page there instead of leaving the app. The in-app WKWebView keeps normal website data and provides back, forward, reload and signup controls. Automatic local email/password suggestions, editor generators, Generate 5 More, bulk import, one-tap copy and Keychain persistence remain included.

files.name: Next Accounts 1.0.3 — Platform Signup Links
files.notes: Keeps the compact platform status workflow: tap Apple, Google, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter or TikTok to toggle its saved green state; press and hold to open that platform's official account-creation page in the system browser without changing status. Includes automatic local email/password suggestions, editor generators, Generate 5 More, bulk import, one-tap copy and Keychain persistence. Suggested Gmail addresses are not registered accounts and availability is not guaranteed.

files.name: Next Accounts 1.0.2 — Automatic Emails
files.notes: Credential-free public build. Generates unique Gmail-style address suggestions and passwords locally for all 22 starting accounts. Upgrades preserve existing addresses and fill previously blank saved slots once. The account editor can generate a new email or password separately, and Generate 5 More creates five complete local entries. Platform status chips, bulk import, one-tap copy and Keychain persistence remain included. Suggested addresses are not registered Gmail accounts and availability is not guaranteed.

files.name: Next Accounts 1.0.1 — Private Slots & Platform Status
files.notes: Credential-free public build. Creates 22 blank private slots and unique passwords locally on-device; upgrades keep only the first legacy account and replace the other 21 with blank slots. Adds compact per-account Apple, Google, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter and TikTok status chips, account editing, bulk email import, one-tap copy and Keychain persistence.
